transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: METRO 500 IAH Downtown Direct connects the airport non-stop with George R. Brown Convention Center. Boarding is in Terminal E on Level 2 at door E201, near the Ride App Pick-Up area. A one-way trip costs USD 4.50; buses run daily from 05:30 to 20:00 every 30 minutes. There is luggage space, accessibility for passengers with reduced mobility and free Wi-Fi.

sleep.title: Where to sleep
sleep.text: Minute Suites is in Terminal C near gate C14 after security. Passengers can use a private space to sleep, relax and work, as well as a shower.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: IAH has rooms and Mamava pods for nursing and expressing milk, children’s rooms and changing tables. Mother’s Rooms are in Terminal A near gates A1 and A17 and in Terminal C near C5. Mamava pods are in Terminal B near B21, Terminal C near C34 and Terminal E near E12; the children’s room in Terminal D is near D15.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: Free Wi-Fi is available throughout IAH’s terminals, including parking garages. Select Free Airport WIFI, wait for the login page, accept the terms and press Submit. The support number is 1-844-831-0999.
